messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
To what tightening torque must the anchor rods (HAS-U M16) of the columns of the MA STAR 3.5 lift be tightened?

response.text: A quale coppia di serraggio devono essere serrate le barre di ancoraggio (HAS-U M16) dei montanti del ponte sollevatore MA STAR 3.5?
